scope: Disposable HRDMO fields: base translate values plus owner ID, IME mode, number/time formats, default century, custom format family and formatted length; export, vacant-target creation, update/add, refusals and durable review; same database; trusted service test approval, not installed UI
checks: Export carries every base translate value with effective dating in canonical order
Export states owner ID, IME mode, number/time format, default century, format family and formatted length only where not New Field defaults
Vacant-target preview then apply creates the field and all translate values, with exact readback
A property-only update (owner ID) saves the field definition and verifies the full payload
A format family absent from the target blocks preview
Unchanged repeat import writes nothing and preserves PDM/XTM/PJM counters
Translate-only update changes and adds values without re-saving the unchanged field definition
A target-only translate value blocks preview; migration never deletes translate values
Translated (language) rows refuse the complete migration scope
Durable migration review stages the translated field and project without writing; approved apply verifies both
